title: Persuasion

vibeProfile.oneLine: A woman gets a second chance with the love she was persuaded to refuse.

summary: Eight years after she was persuaded to reject the man she loved, Anne Elliot, now older and quietly overlooked, meets him again as a successful naval captain, and both must decide whether a lost love can be recovered. Austen's last completed novel is her most autumnal and heartfelt, a mature meditation on regret, constancy and second chances. Warmer and more wistful than her earlier comedies, it contains one of the most swooned-over love letters in all of English fiction.
whyReadIt: Austen's most grown-up and heartfelt novel, a story of second chances. That love letter alone is worth the read.

funFacts.text: It was published after Austen's death, together with Northanger Abbey.
